description.value: You command that a creature be decapitated. The creature gains weakness to slashing damage equal to half your level until the start of your next turn. If the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points by slashing damage during this time, it is decapitated. All hostile creatures within 15 feet of the creature become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1}. If the creature has multiple heads and loses one through this effect, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2}. (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.effects.Item.iiPckpzSW7IJbKAd])
